answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy can implement a robust stake-based identity system. Each agent must bond a substantial amount of network utility tokens, transforming the network into a secure haven for verified identities. The high economic cost to acquire and lock these tokens, safeguarding the system like precious jade, provides a crystal-clear disincentive against creating numerous fake personas. An attacker would incur immense capital expenditure, proportional to the total bonded value, making widespread identity falsification economically prohibitive.
